name: The Adventurer
summary: In Teldrassil, you find a lost journal meant for Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar. Its pages follow an unknown traveler's quiet journeys and camping outings.

sections.title: A Wanderer's Journal
sections.body: Among Teldrassil's boughs and roots, you find a journal left behind. Its nameless writer tells of modest wanderings and the simple pleasure of camping beneath the twilight canopy.

sections.title: Delivery to Dolanaar
sections.body: You can carry the journal toward Dolanaar instead of leaving it in the wilderness. Lyreena Duskblade waits near the night elf settlement to receive its lost pages.

faq.q: What is the journal mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: The journal is a plain notebook found in Teldrassil's wilds. Its entries tell of an unknown traveler's quiet journeys and fondness for camping outdoors.
Lyreena Duskblade is a night elf waiting near Dolanaar to receive the lost journal.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The story takes place in Teldrassil's wilderness around Dolanaar.

faq.q: Does the journal describe dangerous monsters or battles?
faq.answer: No. The journal tells of an unknown person's ordinary wanderings and enjoyment of camping, not dangerous monsters or battles.
Alliance members exploring Teldrassil can return the journal, especially novice night elves near Dolanaar.

faq.q: Why turn the journal in to Dolanaar?
faq.answer: Dolanaar is a central gathering place and crossroads in this part of Teldrassil. Lyreena Duskblade waits nearby to receive the journal.

angles.text: As a young night elf patrolling Teldrassil, you may find travelers' signs and carry lost keepsakes to wanderers like Lyreena Duskblade.
As an Alliance novice beneath the World Tree, you help keep the groves in order by returning lost belongings to fellow travelers.
